- No file changes detected in this version.
- Content and features remain the same as previous release.

Initial release of scaling-strategy skill.

- Provides a complete playbook for solopreneurs looking to scale beyond solo operations.
- Covers scaling readiness, identifying bottlenecks, automation, delegation strategies, and hiring (contractors vs employees).
- Includes detailed steps for documenting processes (SOPs) and building a small team.
- Designed to support sustainable growth and avoid common scaling pitfalls.
- Triggered by natural queries like "scale my business", "grow beyond solo", "delegate", and "sustainable growth".
